row.stage: int (written only when stages map contains key; deserializer stores only >0)
row.flags: comma-separated enum names (written when flags map contains key; unknown names ignored on load)

load_quirks: knowledge state is cleared before load
duplicate research rows after the first do not update stage/flags because processing is guarded by !isResearchKnown(key)
addAutoUnlockResearch runs after knowledge rows are loaded
rows are inserted with raw Map.put semantics
array values are copied raw without the public 0..500 clamp
extra array elements are ignored; missing elements stay zero
